items.title: 'Legend' Pete Rose receives posthumous presidential pardon from Trump
items.summary: President Donald Trump said he has posthumously pardoned Pete Rose more than two years after the baseball star's death and a year after he was reinstated by MLB.

items.title: Rockies trade for ChiSox's Castillo, Martin
items.summary: The Rockies acquired pitchers Luis Castillo and Davis Martin from the White Sox for left-hander Sean Sullivan and catching prospect Douglas Veliz.

items.title: Source: Mets begin rebuilding bullpen, reach 3-year deal with Hernandez
items.summary: The Mets reached a three-year, $12 million deal with Darwinzon Hernandez, a source told ESPN, helping a relief corps that underwent an overhaul this past summer.

items.title: Welcome back: Twins reunite with veteran RHP Gray on two-year deal
items.summary: The Twins have signed free agent right-hander Sonny Gray to a two-year contract, the team announced. The deal is for $55 million and includes an opt-out after the first season, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

items.title: Manfred says MLB owners won't OK deal without cap as lockout looms
items.summary: Commissioner Rob Manfred said owners will not accept any deal without a salary cap, leaving MLB on track for a lockout that could threaten the 2027 season.

items.title: Coveted May excited to tap into young 'energy' with White Sox
items.summary: Newly signed White Sox pitcher Dustin May said he's excited to join another young, up-and-coming team after signing a three-year, $52.5 million contract.

items.title: MLB expects $4B Angels sale to Kroenke to close in January
items.summary: Major League Baseball expects the proposed sale of the Los Angeles Angels to Kroenke Sports and Entertainment at a $4 billion evaluation to take place in January.

items.title: Mariners acquire 3B Garcia from Royals in six-player trade
items.summary: The Royals have traded third baseman Maikel Garcia to the Mariners in exchange for right-hander Bryce Miller as part of a six-player trade.
